title: An engine error inside the variant loop ends the run at once, and is not recorded as a variant's failure.
why: behavioural spec 'execute' (ADR 0019): an engine error is not a closure's verdict and is not recorded as one — when any operation 'execute' sends answers with an error, including a 'serve-variant' inside the loop, 'execute' fails at once with that error and the variants after it do not run. The every-variant-runs guarantee is about what a test decided; an engine that cannot arm this variant cannot arm the next one either.
note: 'session-not-found' is what a lost session looks like from the SDK, which owns that session's lifetime end to end: reaching a user means the engine lost it, never that the caller did anything wrong.
